findings.title: Potential sensitive credential logging
findings.potential_policy_consideration: This log statement appears to include authentication credentials.

code_evidence.snippet: logger.info("Login attempt for %s with password %s", username, password)

policy_reference.title: Sensitive Data Must Not Be Logged

findings.why_this_matters: Credentials in logs can be exposed through monitoring tools, support systems, error reports, backups, or unauthorized log access.
findings.recommended_action: Remove the password from the log message. Log only a non-sensitive event, a masked identifier, or an internal correlation ID if needed.

confidence.label: high
confidence.basis: A deterministic AST rule detected a sensitive identifier passed to a recognized logging or output function.

findings.disclaimer: This is automated developer guidance, not legal advice or a legal-compliance determination.
